title: Last visit to Saddam Hussein before the Iraq bombing

tellings.quote: But when it became clear, when it was already certain there would be bombings and that Saddam Hussein would be killed, I flew to him.

plain: The former president of one of Russia's republics says that in 2003, once it was certain that Iraq would be bombed and that its ruler Saddam Hussein would be killed, he flew to Baghdad to see Saddam one last time. He also names Saddam's son Qusay and the Russian leader Boris Yeltsin, and tells it as a first-hand glimpse of the final days before the war.
